latest_release.name: FigCraft v0.16.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(collab): place keyed-list puts through an index within a batch by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1893
* Reject fractional index in proto.interaction.remove and set by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1874
* Reject fractional index in layout.setTrack by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1892
* Reject invalid dashes in node.set instead of dropping entries by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1899
* perf(color): sort gradient stops once per diamond texture by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1894
* perf(format): drop dangling Penpot token aliases with a worklist by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1897
* M8: an ellipse whose start has gone round many turns keeps its sweep in .fig by @samhyun in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1891
* M7: a file tab's menu and the board bar's shape menu read in the light theme by @aleksei-suholita in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1890
* M8: a click with the Bend tool curves a sharp point, its handles along the line between its neighbours (#1875) by @TrevorBrown-dev in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1877
* M4: wrap style on a text layer: Auto, Balance and Pretty decide where its lines break (#1827) by @TrevorBrown-dev in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1871
* fix(format): index kiwi field lookups and bound schema and empty-array growth by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1896
* fix(pathops): sanitize a brush's width profile once before sampling by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1948
* perf(text): compute each glyph's cluster end once per run by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1963
* perf(doc,engine): rebuild a widget by removing its children in one pass by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1967
* perf(engine): look up a component's asset root once per usage report, and skip mode migration without instances by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1966
* perf(collab): check a replaced list's entries against sets, not a scan per entry by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1962
* fix(format): a saved file replaces its predecessor with the same permissions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1957
* fix(engine): never let document text close the generated HTML style element by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1955
* perf(engine): keep each events.poll topic once by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1935
* fix(doc): list a page once however often a file lists it by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1927
* fix(layout): end the fill distribution loop when no child can freeze by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1926
* fix(svg): refuse a document compressed twice and charge a refused embedded one by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1924
* fix(mcp): render prompt placeholders in one pass over the template by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1922
* fix(render): check the nesting limit for mask content and bound GIF frame buffers by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1925
* perf(engine): list a few step names in a missing-reference error by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1941
* perf(svg): hash an embedded image's bytes once per import by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1945
* fix(doc): bound the string bytes an expression holds and stop concatenating at the cap by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/figcraft/pull/1950
* fix(engine): hold a plugin's text.preview to the permissions of the command it previews by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/story

Frames, auto layout, components and variants, vector networks, styles, variables and prototypes,
